title: Override the Default
goal: Implement the required trait method and override the default behavior.

slots.label: method override

hints: Check the trait definition: user takes &self and returns &str, and notify returns String.
The method signatures in your impl block must match the trait definition exactly, including receiver types like &self.
explanation: Trait method overrides must match the declared signature in the trait definition. Changing the return type of user from &str to String triggers E0053, and omitting &self triggers E0185. For notify, changing &self to &mut self causes E0186, while returning () instead of String causes E0308. Matching the trait signature exactly allows custom implementations to seamlessly replace default behavior.
